0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Alsa is excited to see you.

48.original: Ah, one of Master Matoya's guests. You've come at an opportune time.

49.original: I was preparing to take a walk and tend to the candles about Slitherbough, and I would ask you assist me. I can think of no finer opportunity to learn more of our people.

50.original: Take these three candles, and replace any that appear to be nearly spent. A simple task, I know, but I believe it will prove most illuminating.

51.original: You need only place the three candles I gave you. I will take care of the rest.

52.original: A fresh candle. How thoughtful of you.

53.original: Whenever I'm feeling stressed, watching the flames helps settle my nerves. Something about the way they flicker and dance is so soothing to me. Perhaps you should give it a try sometime.

54.original: Pay me no mind. I'll be returning to work soon enough.

55.original: Thanks, <hex:020811E905FF056D697373FF076D697374657203>. You're real good at placing candles.

56.original: Mama says the night sky has candles. Lots and lots of candles. So many you can't count them all. I bet I could, though!

57.original: Have you seen the candles outside, in the sky? There's so many! Mama said there's too many to count, but I bet I could if I wanted.

58.original: They're really pretty, but I think I like the candles in here more.

59.original: Hey <hex:020811E905FF056D697373FF076D697374657203>, why do you dress so funny? Is it for your work? Mama makes medicine and Papa is a guard. He's always busy outside, so I try to help lots and lots inside.

60.original: Beautiful, aren't they? Like the souls of the departed, burning bright in the sunless sea above.

61.original: I often come here to pay respects to our forebears, reflecting on the sacrifices that allowed us to live as we do now.

62.original: What do you see when you look into the flames?

63.original: You are returned, and enlightened by the experience, I trust. We are a quiet people, but conversation comes easy in the presence of the candles.

64.original: Before the Flood, our worship would no doubt have been seen as profane. Sacrilege...

65.original: But it is the expression of our faith that defines us, not the object of our worship.

66.original: I can but imagine what change may come to the Night's Blessed should the night ever return to us.

67.original: I can but imagine what change will come to the Night's Blessed now that the night has returned to us.
